what_this_is: The Workshop row for tools/walk-nested-input-within-limits: check untrusted nested input against depth and size limits before it is rendered or stored.

payload.label: Check nested input within limits
payload.job: Check an untrusted nested value (an imported document, pasted rich text, list row values from an AI) before it is rendered or stored: refuse it in plain words when it is nested deeper than 100 levels, holds more than 100,000 values, or refers back to itself
payload.description: Give value (any JSON) and, optionally, limits ({ max_depth, max_nodes }) tighter than the defaults. Returns ok and nodes when the value is fine, or ok false with reason (too_deep, too_many_nodes, cycle), the limit crossed and said, the words the person reads. The walk keeps its own stack, so a very deep value never overflows the call stack.

provenance.source: moved from Trillion-X/trillion parts/bounded-walk.mjs and parts/bounded-walk.json, with its tests
